User Story — Modern Card Component
  
  As a product designer or front-end developer working within the Marsh Design
  System,
  I want a flexible, accessible modern card component
  So that I can quickly compose consistent content surfaces across dashboards,
  portals, and product pages without building from scratch each time.

  ---
  Acceptance Criteria
  
  Structure
  - Card supports a header, body, footer, and optional image/media slot
  - All sections are optional — card degrades gracefully with any combination
  - Card width is fluid (fills container) with a fixed min-width of 280px
  
  Variants
  - Type: Default, Outlined, Elevated, Ghost
  - State: Default, Hover, Active, Focus, Disabled
  - Orientation: Vertical, Horizontal
  - Size: Compact, Default, Expanded

  Accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA)
  - Focus state is visible and uses the MDS Focus border component
  - Interactive cards have a single focusable element (not nested interactive
  children)
  - Non-interactive cards are not in the tab order
  - All images include alt text slots in the design spec
  - Colour is never the sole indicator of meaning (status uses icon + label +
  colour)

  Responsiveness
  - Horizontal orientation collapses to vertical below 480px
  - Card decks reflow to single column on mobile 

  Design tokens
  - All colours bound to MDS semantic tokens (supports Light/Dark mode)
  - Border, shadow, and radius use token values — no hardcoded styles

[SUCCESS] **Created: "Modern Card Component"**
Built with `Card`, `Box`, `Stack`, `Typography`, `Button`....

**Layout:** Horizontal Stack - inline element alignment with automatic spacing.
